result.summary: The intersection features a wide, multi-lane roadway with high-visibility crosswalk markings and traffic signals. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge create a car-centric environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the center of the image.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide lanes and multiple through-lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway running horizontally across the frame.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing a baseline level of safety. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to multi-lane traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a mid-point refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway (Bryn Mawr Av)

hazards.name: Wide curb radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians increase pedestrian exposure to turning vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radius
hazards.description: The curb radius at the intersection corner allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the intersection corner near the Rite Aid.

hazards.name: Pedestrian Exposure
hazards.description: The width of the intersection increases the time pedestrians spend in the conflict zone with vehicles without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and reduce vehicle turning speeds.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
